Rippling's Compound Startup Playbook

Rippling CEO @parkerconrad discusses Rippling's "heretic" product strategy

"It resembles a lot of software companies that were built more than 20 years ago ... they actually look like compound software businesses. 

Eventually, all of these markets got crowded with companies doing this one narrow thing. Point solutions. Point SaaS. There's actually a lot of disadvantages to that approach. The types of problems that you can solve for customers tend to be much more limited."

Source: @parkerconrad talking with @ycombinator's @garrytan
